summary: Tested Content Synchronization Engine — backend POST /api/doogie/sync-search + frontend SyncedResults integration in DashboardMockup. All 7 backend pytest cases passed and all frontend UI expectations verified (intent badge, community badge, all required sync-section-* keys, compliance banner, mic button present, absence on first load).

issues: React DOM warnings observed: 'fetchpriority' should be 'fetchPriority'; hydration warning about <span> inside <option> (from x-source instrumentation, not a functional bug but should be reviewed)

action_items: None blocking. Optional: clean up React hydration warning for <span> nested in <option> and fetchpriority casing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 12,915 lines — file size violates <700-line guideline; recommend splitting Content Sync Engine into a dedicated module (doogie_sync.py).

Section discriminator field is 'kind' in payload; frontend/other consumers must key on 'kind' not 'type' (review request wording mentioned 'type' — payload uses 'kind'). Not a bug, just a naming clarification for API docs.
Rate limit (30/min per IP) is implemented on the endpoint; verified not hit by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend response shape: sections[].kind (not .type). Values seen: MarketInsights, IntentInsights, CommunityProfile, PropertyIntel, Glossary, FAQs, Communities, RelatedSearches. Frontend renders these with data-testid='sync-section-<lowercase>' plus a paired '-toggle' testid. sync-intent-badge text is 'Intent · Buying/Selling/Browsing'. sync-community-badge text prefixed with '📍'. Empty body correctly returns sections=[]. Surrey whole-word matching works. Voice mic button (data-testid=floating-filters-voice) present with title 'Ask Doogie by voice'.
